# Nuevo Automations

> Nuevo Automations (Nuevo Automations FZE LLC) is a marketing agency registered in Sharjah Publishing City Free Zone, United Arab Emirates, founded by Nawaf Allahham. It focuses on premium wellness and supplement brands selling online in the UAE, running Meta (Instagram and Facebook) click-to-WhatsApp ads that send buyers to a WhatsApp chat instead of a landing page, and sells M2S (Message to Sale): an AI sales assistant that replies on WhatsApp in English or Arabic, closes the sale in the chat, follows up on abandoned carts, unpaid payment links and quiet leads, and sends a monthly results report.

Key facts:
- Serves businesses across the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the other emirates), in English and Arabic.
- M2S runs on the client's own WhatsApp number and on OrcaFlo, a WhatsApp AI platform Nuevo Automations built and runs itself.
- The AI never invents prices or products; anything it can't answer is handed to the client's team with a chat summary.
- Pricing: one fixed monthly fee, quoted in writing after a free 30-minute audit. No public price list. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta and is not part of the fee.
- No guaranteed results. Partners report 50–60% more revenue from the same traffic after full rollout, with no extra headcount, and the best return on ad spend seen, on client Khaleej ParaPharma, is 30x, not a typical result; individual results vary. Clients get a monthly M2S Results report showing conversations, orders, revenue and what follow-ups recovered.
- Peak Labs (supplements, UAE) reports a 90x faster first reply, 53% more orders a month and 74% of chats handled without a person (figures as of October 2026).
- Licence no. 4431808.01. Contact: phone +971 50 854 9171, WhatsApp +1 555-773-8409, nawafallahham@nuevoautomations.com. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nuevoautomations/. Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/nuevoautomations. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nuevoautomations/. Founder on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nawafallahham/. Crunchbase: https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/nuevo-automations.

- [Taking payments on WhatsApp in the UAE](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-payment-links-uae/): why WhatsApp Pay is not live in the UAE, payment links, Stripe, Ziina, Telr, Tabby and Tamara
- [Selling supplements online in the UAE](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/sell-supplements-online-uae/): EDE and Dubai Municipality registration, e-commerce licences, Arabic rules, ad approvals, payments
- [Shopify WhatsApp integration](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/shopify-whatsapp-integration/): Shopify Messaging, Meta's official app and third-party apps, with prices and template categories

- [Instagram DM automation rules](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/instagram-dm-automation-rules/): the 24-hour window, human agent tag, comment-to-DM private replies, rate limits, Instagram vs WhatsApp
- [ManyChat pricing 2026](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/manychat-pricing/): the five plans since March 2026, active contacts, WhatsApp costs, ManyChat vs WhatsApp-first platforms
- [Meta Business AI on WhatsApp vs a custom assistant](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/meta-business-ai-whatsapp/): what Meta Business Agent does, US$2 per million tokens, excluded industries including Health, limits
- [WhatsApp Flows](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-flows/): in-chat forms for leads, bookings and product choice, how they are sent, device support and limits
- [Cash on delivery confirmation on WhatsApp](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/cash-on-delivery-whatsapp-confirmation-uae/): utility template rules, a confirmation flow, COD trends in the UAE, moving buyers to prepaid
- [WhatsApp marketing rules in the UAE](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-marketing-rules-uae/): Meta opt-in and opt-out, messaging limits, per-user caps, penalties, Cabinet Resolution 56 of 2024 and the PDPL
- [WhatsApp Business app vs API](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-business-app-vs-api/): devices, broadcasts, automation, pricing, coexistence, blue tick and Meta One
- [How to get the WhatsApp green tick in the UAE](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-green-tick-uae/): Official Business Account requirements on the API and Meta One verification for the app
- [Sending bulk WhatsApp messages in the UAE](https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/bulk-whatsapp-messages-uae/): broadcast lists, business broadcasts, API templates, limits, cost and consent
